caption: The drawing depicts an object resembling a decorative pouch or small bag, split vertically into two color sections: the left half is red and the right half is a light cream or off-white. The surface is adorned with repeated dashed lines suggesting stitching, using blue and red colors. The upper edge of the object is slightly curved, and there is a red and white twisted cord attached at the top, ending in two pom-poms. The object tapers downward to a point, and from this point hangs a large multi-colored tassel in red, pink, and white. Three smaller, round, beaded elements hang from each bottom corner and the center, each with red as the dominant color. The lower section of both color fields features an embroidered or stitched paisley or spiral motif; the left is yellow with red outlining and the right is a similar shape in yellow and orange on red background. The object is rendered on a plain background. A faint signature and date are visible in the lower right corner.
title: Bag
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
